definition: MCP Protocol Basics is a core concept in Agentic AI. It refers to the techniques, principles and practices that let a practitioner work effectively with this topic in real systems.

theory.heading: What MCP Protocol Basics is
theory.body: MCP Protocol Basics describes the methods and patterns used within Agentic AI to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: MCP Protocol Basics is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why MCP Protocol Basics matters
theory.body: Without MCP Protocol Basics, systems built with Agentic AI are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How MCP Protocol Basics works
theory.body: The mechanism behind MCP Protocol Basics follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of MCP Protocol Basics.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of MCP Protocol Basics
theory.body: MCP Protocol Basics offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
